wargear.name: Vigil banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Sodality's colours, gilded by ten thousand years of ceremony. Every model in the unit gains +1 Willpower and +1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Ablative gilding
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A layered auramite coating that sheds blows as a second skin. The model's Invulnerable Save becomes 5+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Mantle of the Silent
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hunter's cloak woven with null-fibre that dims the wearer to the senses. The bearer gains Shrouded (6+), or one step better if they already have it.

wargear.name: Reliquary plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A sarcophagus-ward of Auramite lined with the names of the Dreadnought's former masters. The model gains +1 Wound.

option.text: Any Custodian Guard may exchange their guardian spear for a Ceremonial vigil-glaive
Any Sentinel Guard may exchange their sentinel warblade for Paired sentinel warblades
The Shield Captain may take a Castellan's greatblade instead of their blade and shield
Any Venatari may exchange their kinetic destroyer and buckler for a Cull-bolt carbine
The unit may wear Mantles of the Silent
The Sodality may carry a Vigil banner
The Sodality may be coated in Ablative gilding
May be fitted with Reliquary plate

modifiers.text: Spear-drilled for the throne room, not the field: +1 I, -1 M.
Shieldwall drilled to stillness: +1 LD, -1 I.
Zealots of the spearhead: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Marksmen of the Ten Thousand: +1 BS, -1 WS.

rites.name: Defenders of the Palace
rites.flavor: The Throne is the last thing that falls, and the Ten Thousand are what stands in front of it.
rites.text: Adrasite and Pyrithite Guard may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1), and Custodian Guard, Sentinel Guard, Adrasite and Pyrithite Guard Sodalities gain a 5+ Invulnerable Save if they had worse. They do not leave their post: no Fast Attack, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units. A Shield Captain must be included.

modifiers.text: Defenders of the Palace: 5+ Invulnerable Save.

require.note: A Shield Captain commands the watch.

rites.name: The Talon Hunt
rites.flavor: Someone in the Palace has a secret. The Ten Thousand and the Talons agree on the remedy.
rites.text: Venatari Sodalities may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1), and every Assassin costs 20 points less. The hunt is quiet and light: no War Engine or Lord of War units. At least one Venatari Sodality and one Assassin are required.

require.note: Bring a Venatari Sodality to run down the quarry.
A Talon of the Emperor must be present.

rites.name: The Emperor's Will
rites.flavor: Valdor does not command the Ten Thousand. He only says aloud what they already know.
rites.text: Every Legio Custodes unit gains +1 Willpower and +1 Cool. Constantin Valdor must lead the army. Machine-servitors are not welcome at his side: no Vagus automata (Castellax, Domitar, Thanatar, Vorax or Vultarax) and at most one War Engine.

rites.name: The Vigil of Ancients
rites.flavor: Within each Contemptor sleeps a warrior who knew the Emperor before He was called that.
rites.text: Contemptor-Galatus, Contemptor-Achillus and Telemon Heavy Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots, cost 20 points less and gain Line (1). The Sodalities remain with the Throne: no Custodian Guard or Sentinel Guard Sodalities. At least two War Engine units are required.
